# Firebird Trace Analyzer

Cross-platform open-source desktop application (Windows / macOS / Linux; .NET 10 + Avalonia)
for reading, exploring and reporting on **Firebird 5.x trace & audit logs** produced by the
`fbtrace` utility. Parses logs into typed events, renders millions of rows responsively,
and exports polished reports. Licensed PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0.

Key capabilities: load logs from local files or over SSH/SFTP; filter, search and sort
events; optional local SQLite event store with deduplication and a read-only SQL console;
live report designer exporting PDF / DOCX / XLSX / CSV; sort & filter plugin SDK; English
and Russian localization; light/dark themes.
